name: Equipment Return Acknowledgment (Onsite)
description: Signed by the team member returning equipment in person, team member and equipment details, an onsite turnover commitment, declaration, and signature.
content:
Team Member Information

Return Mode: Onsite.

Equipment Assigned

Asset NameAsset TagSerial No.Condition
{{ASSET_NAME}}{{ASSET_TAG}}{{SERIAL_NUMBER}}

Contact Details Confirmation

Return Commitment

Return Location: Asset Team Room, {{ASSET_TEAM_ADDRESS}}. Turnover Hours: {{ASSET_TEAM_SCHEDULE}}.

  1. Select a target date on or before the turnover deadline stated in your notice. A later date cannot be submitted.
  2. Turn the equipment over at the Asset Team Room during Asset Management Team operating hours on that date. There is no time slot to arrange.
  3. Equipment is handed over in person. Leaving it at a workstation, with a colleague, or at reception is not an accepted turnover.
  4. Ensure the turnover is completed successfully. If anything prevents you from completing it on your committed date, contact the Asset Management Team the same day at {{ASSET_TEAM_EMAIL}} or {{ASSET_TEAM_MOBILE}} so we can support you.

Equipment Notes

Declaration

I, {{TM_FULL_NAME}}, Employee ID {{EMPLOYEE_ID}}, declare and confirm the following:

  1. The equipment listed in this acknowledgment is, or was, issued to me by GoTeam and held under my custody and accountability as its assigned custodian.
  2. I acknowledge receipt of the Equipment Return Notice issued to me, and I understand that I am required to return all of the listed equipment to GoTeam's custody.
  3. I agree to return the listed equipment in person at the Asset Team Room by the deadline stated.
  4. The equipment I am returning is complete, including all accompanying accessories. Where any listed item is not in my possession, or is not in serviceable condition, I have declared this in the Equipment Notes together with the reason.
  5. I understand that failure to comply may result in the consequences detailed in this notice, including the withholding of the Asset Management Team's clearance sign-off.
  6. The information I have given in this acknowledgment is true and correct to the best of my knowledge. I understand that this acknowledgment forms part of GoTeam's asset records and may be relied upon as evidence of the matters declared here.

Independent Obligation Notice

The obligation to return all company and client-issued equipment is an independent contractual obligation under GoTeam's Asset Management Policy and your employment agreement. This obligation exists regardless of whether this acknowledgment form is signed or returned. GoTeam will rely on the issuance of this notice as formal evidence that the return obligation has been communicated to you.

name: Equipment Return Acknowledgment (Remote / Courier)
description: Signed by the team member shipping equipment back, team member and equipment details, a courier/branch return commitment, shipping cost authorization, declaration, and signature.
content:
Team Member Information

Return Mode: Remote.

Equipment Assigned

Asset NameAsset TagSerial No.Condition
{{ASSET_NAME}}{{ASSET_TAG}}{{SERIAL_NUMBER}}

Contact Details Confirmation

Return Commitment

GoTeam maintains active corporate accounts with the following couriers:

  • JRS Express (Recommended) — Credit Account: Go Virtual Assistants Inc., Account No. 110604. Crating available.
  • LBC — Account: Go Virtual Assistants, Inc., Account No. 10809702 (National Standard).

Freight Account: GoTeam corporate account. Declared Value: {{DECLARED_VALUE}}.

What happens after you submit: submission of this section is your branch confirmation, so the branch you name must be accurate. Choose the branch of your selected courier that is nearest and most convenient to you, and enter its name exactly as it appears on the courier's official branch locator or on the branch storefront. The authorization we issue names that branch and no other.

  1. Upon submission, the Asset Management Team coordinates with the courier's corporate account management team and issues a formal shipment authorization naming your confirmed branch.
  2. You are copied on that communication.
  3. Do not proceed to the branch until you have received your copy of the authorization, as the branch must first acknowledge the arrangement on their end.
  4. If you need to change the branch after submitting, tell the Asset Management Team before you travel. A new authorization must be issued naming the new branch. A branch that is not named on the authorization cannot accept the shipment under GoTeam's corporate account.
  5. Freight is charged to GoTeam's corporate account at the counter. You will not be asked to pay.
  6. Lodge the shipment during your chosen branch's operating hours on your committed date. Operating hours vary by branch, so confirm them with the branch beforehand.
  7. Ensure the lodgement is completed successfully. If the branch declines the shipment, cannot locate the authorization, or you encounter any other difficulty, contact the Asset Management Team the same day at {{ASSET_TEAM_EMAIL}} or {{ASSET_TEAM_MOBILE}}.

Equipment Notes

Shipping Cost Authorization

I, {{TM_FULL_NAME}}, acknowledge that my equipment return will be shipped using GoTeam's prescribed corporate courier account, and that the freight cost will be billed directly to GoTeam at the point of shipment. I authorize GoTeam to recover the actual cost of this shipment through payroll processing, where the cost is chargeable to me under GoTeam policy. I acknowledge that the amount recovered is the actual cost of the shipment as confirmed by the courier, and that a copy of the supporting record will be made available to me on request.

Declaration

I, {{TM_FULL_NAME}}, Employee ID {{EMPLOYEE_ID}}, declare and confirm the following:

  1. The equipment listed in this acknowledgment is, or was, issued to me by GoTeam and held under my custody and accountability as its assigned custodian.
  2. I acknowledge receipt of the Equipment Return Notice issued to me, and I understand that I am required to return all of the listed equipment to GoTeam's custody.
  3. I agree to ship the listed equipment from the courier branch I have named by the deadline stated.
  4. The equipment I am returning is complete, including all accompanying accessories. Where any listed item is not in my possession, or is not in serviceable condition, I have declared this in the Equipment Notes together with the reason.
  5. I understand that failure to comply may result in the consequences detailed in this notice, including the withholding of the Asset Management Team's clearance sign-off.
  6. The information I have given in this acknowledgment is true and correct to the best of my knowledge. I understand that this acknowledgment forms part of GoTeam's asset records and may be relied upon as evidence of the matters declared here.

Independent Obligation Notice

The obligation to return all company and client-issued equipment is an independent contractual obligation under GoTeam's Asset Management Policy and your employment agreement. This obligation exists regardless of whether this acknowledgment form is signed or returned. GoTeam will rely on the issuance of this notice as formal evidence that the return obligation has been communicated to you.

name: Authority to Deduct, Asset Loss/Damage/Non-Return
description: The charge path, basis, evidence, finding, amount, method of recovery, statutory terms, and a three-party signature block (Team Member, Asset Management Team, People & Culture/Payroll).
content:
Section 1 - Case Information

Team Member: {{TM_FULL_NAME}} (Employee ID: {{EMPLOYEE_ID}})
Client or Account: {{CLIENT_NAME}}
Leadership Coach: {{LEADERSHIP_COACH}}
Asset Owner: {{ASSET_OWNER}}
Asset Team Officer: {{CASE_OFFICER}}
ATD Reference: {{ATD_REFERENCE}}

Date the return was requested: {{DATE_RETURN_REQUESTED}}
Return date that was set: {{TARGET_RETURN_DATE}}
Date received: {{DATE_RECEIVED}}
Date assessed: {{DATE_ASSESSED}}

Section 2 - Basis

The equipment was not returned, or was returned in a condition requiring this authority, on one of the following bases:

  1. Not returned
  2. Lost or damaged in custody
  3. Returned needing repair
  4. Not returned after international travel
  5. Component not returned
  6. Lost or damaged in transit outside the prescribed courier

Evidence of issuance and custody on file (at least one required):

Section 3 - Equipment

Asset NameAsset TagSerial No.Finding
{{ASSET_NAME}}{{ASSET_TAG}}{{SERIAL_NUMBER}}{{ASSET_CONDITION}}

Section 4 - Finding

Select one:

  1. Negligence established
  2. Unauthorized modification
  3. Accidental, no negligence
  4. Fair wear and tear, no amount charged

Section 5 - Amount

Basis of the amount: {{AMOUNT_BASIS}}
Supporting document reference: {{SUPPORTING_DOC_REF}}
Amount in figures: {{AMOUNT_FIGURES}}
Amount in words: {{AMOUNT_WORDS}}

This amount is transcribed from the determination recorded at Case Details - it is not negotiated at signing.

Section 6 - Method of Recovery

Select one:

  1. Single deduction from final pay. No installment schedule applies.
  2. Installment schedule.

Capped at [CAP]% of net pay per period. Deductions never bring net pay below the statutory minimum wage.

Section 7 - Statutory Terms

This deduction is made pursuant to Article 113 of the Labor Code of the Philippines and GoTeam's Asset Management Policy. The amount deducted is a fixed, documented amount determined under Section 5 above - it carries no penalty element, no uplift, and no handling charge, and reflects the actual documented cost only. This is not a penalty. The Team Member's right to dispute this determination is preserved and is not waived by signing this authority. Deductions stop once the amount in Section 5 is fully recovered, or earlier if the matter is otherwise resolved or reversed.

Section 8 - Signatures

Team Member - authorizes the deduction described above.

Asset Management Team - issuing officer.

People and Culture / Payroll - received for processing.

For Office Use Only (Payroll)

name: Authority to Deduct, Asset Settlement and Transfer
description: The team member's own election to keep the equipment and pay for it instead of returning it, election, settlement amount, method of recovery, transfer of ownership, and the same three-party signature block.
content:
Section 1 - Case Information

Team Member: {{TM_FULL_NAME}} (Employee ID: {{EMPLOYEE_ID}})

Leadership Coach: {{LEADERSHIP_COACH}}

ATD Reference: {{ATD_REFERENCE}}

Date the return was requested: {{DATE_RETURN_REQUESTED}}

Section 2 - Election

This is the Team Member's own election, not something GoTeam requires. The Team Member has chosen to keep the equipment in use and settle its value instead of returning it.

Reason for election - select one:

  1. Lost / can't locate
  2. Damaged beyond useful return
  3. Held by a third party
  4. Wishes to retain the asset in use
  5. Other

Section 3 - Equipment

Asset NameAsset TagSerial No.Settlement Amount
{{ASSET_NAME}}{{ASSET_TAG}}{{SERIAL_NUMBER}}{{ASSET_CONDITION}}

Section 4 - Settlement Amount

Basis of the amount: {{AMOUNT_BASIS}}
Supporting document reference: {{SUPPORTING_DOC_REF}}
Amount in figures: {{AMOUNT_FIGURES}}
Amount in words: {{AMOUNT_WORDS}}

Note: no "repair quotation" option applies to a settlement - the basis above is limited to net book value, replacement cost, or program price.

Section 5 - Method of Recovery

Select one:

  1. Single deduction from final pay. No installment schedule applies.
  2. Installment schedule.

Capped at [CAP]% of net pay per period. Deductions never bring net pay below the statutory minimum wage.

Section 6 - Transfer of Ownership

Title to the equipment passes to the Team Member only on full payment. The equipment is taken as-is, with no warranty from GoTeam. Company and client system access is removed on settlement, and the return obligation is discharged on settlement. If the Team Member later locates the equipment and wishes to return it before the amount above is fully recovered, they may do so - the deduction stops and anything already deducted is refunded.

Section 7 - Signatures

Team Member - authorizes the deduction and elects settlement as described above.

Asset Management Team - issuing officer.

People and Culture / Payroll - received for processing.

For Office Use Only (Payroll)
